<div class="parsedown-markdown"><h2 id="54948086_"></h2>
<p>将网页保存为PDF文件的浏览器脚本。</p>
<h3 id="54948086_特性">特性</h3>
<ul>
<li>支持所有网站</li>
<li>可拖动的悬浮按钮</li>
<li>快捷键操作（默认 Alt+U）</li>
<li>自动适配页面尺寸</li>
<li>多种导出选项</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="54948086_手动添加脚本（复制代码）">手动添加脚本（复制代码）</h3>
<p>如果你想手动粘贴代码安装：<br>
若下面的代码无法使用（可能格式问题），可以在这里下载：GongyiChuren/web-to-pdf: Config files for my GitHub profile.<br>
</p><div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[JavaScript] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: javascript; gutter: true">// ==UserScript==
// @name         网页转PDF工具
// @namespace    <a href="http://tampermonkey.net/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow">http://tampermonkey.net/</a>
// @version      2.5.1
// @description  将任意网页转换为PDF文件，可拖动悬浮按钮，自适应页面大小，支持快捷键
// @author       Your Name
// @match        <em>://</em>/*
// @require      <a href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2pdf.js/0.10.1/html2pdf.bundle.min.js" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow">https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2pdf.js/0.10.1/html2pdf.bundle.min.js</a>
// @grant        none
// @run-at       document-end
// ==/UserScript==<p></p>
<p>(function() {
'use strict';</p>
<pre><code>const CONFIG_KEY = 'pdf-tool-config';
let config = {
    buttonVisible: true,
    hotkey: 'Alt+U'
};

function loadConfig() {
    try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(CONFIG_KEY);
        if (saved) config = { ...config, ...JSON.parse(saved) };
    } catch (e) {}
}

function saveConfig() {
    try {
        localStorage.setItem(CONFIG_KEY, JSON.stringify(config));
    } catch (e) {}
}

loadConfig();

function waitForLibrary() {
    return new Promise((resolve) =&amp;gt; {
        const check = setInterval(() =&amp;gt; {
            if (typeof html2pdf !== 'undefined') {
                clearInterval(check);
                resolve();
            }
        }, 100);
    });
}

function createDraggableButton() {
    const btn = document.createElement('div');
    btn.id = 'pdf-tool-btn';
    btn.innerHTML = 'PDF';
    btn.title = '点击打开PDF工具（可拖动）';

    Object.assign(btn.style, {
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '20px',
        right: '20px',
        width: '45px',
        height: '45px',
        borderRadius: '8px',
        background: '#2563eb',
        color: 'white',
        fontSize: '11px',
        fontWeight: 'bold',
        display: config.buttonVisible ? 'flex' : 'none',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        cursor: 'move',
        boxShadow: '0 2px 10px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3)',
        zIndex: '999998',
        userSelect: 'none',
        transition: 'box-shadow 0.2s'
    });

    let isDragging = false;
    let startX, startY, startLeft, startTop;

    btn.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) =&amp;gt; {
        isDragging = true;
        startX = e.clientX;
        startY = e.clientY;
        startLeft = parseInt(btn.style.right) || 20;
        startTop = parseInt(btn.style.bottom) || 20;
        btn.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
        e.preventDefault();
    });

    document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) =&amp;gt; {
        if (!isDragging) return;
        btn.style.right = (startLeft + startX - e.clientX) + 'px';
        btn.style.bottom = (startTop + startY - e.clientY) + 'px';
    });

    document.addEventListener('mouseup', (e) =&amp;gt; {
        if (isDragging) {
            isDragging = false;
            btn.style.cursor = 'move';
            const moved = Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) + Math.abs(e.clientY - startY);
            if (moved &amp;lt; 5) showPanel();
        }
    });

    btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () =&amp;gt; {
        if (!isDragging) btn.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 15px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.5)';
    });

    btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () =&amp;gt; {
        btn.style.boxShadow = '0 2px 10px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3)';
    });

    document.body.appendChild(btn);
}

function setupHotkey() {
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) =&amp;gt; {
        const parts = config.hotkey.toLowerCase().split('+');
        let match = true;

        if (parts.includes('ctrl') &amp;&amp; !e.ctrlKey) match = false;
        if (parts.includes('alt') &amp;&amp; !e.altKey) match = false;
        if (parts.includes('shift') &amp;&amp; !e.shiftKey) match = false;

        const mainKey = parts[parts.length - 1];
        if (e.key.toLowerCase() !== mainKey.toLowerCase()) match = false;

        if (match) {
            e.preventDefault();
            showPanel();
        }
    });
}

function createSettingsPanel() {
    const panel = document.createElement('div');
    panel.id = 'pdf-settings-panel';
    panel.style.display = 'none';

    panel.innerHTML = `
        &amp;lt;div style="position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); z-index: 9999998;" id="pdf-settings-overlay"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
        &amp;lt;div style="position: fixed; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 400px; background: white; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); z-index: 9999999; padding: 25px;"&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 20px;"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;h3 style="margin: 0; font-size: 18px; color: #1e293b;"&amp;gt;&amp;#9881;&amp;#65039; 设置&amp;lt;/h3&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;button id="pdf-settings-close" style="background: none; border: none; font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; color: #64748b;"&amp;gt;×&amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

            &amp;lt;div style="margin-bottom: 20px;"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;label style="display: flex; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; padding: 12px; background: #f8fafc; border-radius: 8px;"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;input type="checkbox" id="pdf-toggle-button" ${config.buttonVisible ? 'checked' : ''} style="margin-right: 10px; width: 18px; height: 18px; cursor: pointer;"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;lt;span style="font-size: 14px; color: #475569;"&amp;gt;显示悬浮按钮&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/label&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

            &amp;lt;div style="margin-bottom: 20px;"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;label style="display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #475569;"&amp;gt;快捷键&amp;lt;/label&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;input type="text" id="pdf-hotkey-input" value="${config.hotkey}" placeholder="例如: Alt+P" style="width: 100%; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; box-sizing: border-box;"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div style="margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: #64748b;"&amp;gt;
                    支持: Ctrl, Alt, Shift + 任意字母&amp;lt;br&amp;gt;
                    例如: Alt+P, Ctrl+Shift+D
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

            &amp;lt;div style="display: flex; gap: 10px;"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;button id="pdf-settings-save" style="flex: 1; padding: 12px; background: #2563eb; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;"&amp;gt;
                    保存
                &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;button id="pdf-settings-cancel" style="flex: 1; padding: 12px; background: #f1f5f9; color: #475569; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer;"&amp;gt;
                    取消
                &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

            &amp;lt;div style="margin-top: 15px; padding: 12px; background: #fef3c7; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: #92400e;"&amp;gt;
                &amp;#128161; 提示：隐藏按钮后，可使用快捷键打开面板
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
    `;

    document.body.appendChild(panel);

    document.getElementById('pdf-settings-overlay').addEventListener('click', hideSettingsPanel);
    document.getElementById('pdf-settings-close').addEventListener('click', hideSettingsPanel);
    document.getElementById('pdf-settings-cancel').addEventListener('click', hideSettingsPanel);
    document.getElementById('pdf-settings-save').addEventListener('click', saveSettings);
}

function showSettingsPanel() {
    document.getElementById('pdf-settings-panel').style.display = 'block';
}

function hideSettingsPanel() {
    document.getElementById('pdf-settings-panel').style.display = 'none';
}

function saveSettings() {
    const buttonVisible = document.getElementById('pdf-toggle-button').checked;
    const hotkey = document.getElementById('pdf-hotkey-input').value.trim();

    if (!hotkey) {
        alert('快捷键不能为空！');
        return;
    }

    config.buttonVisible = buttonVisible;
    config.hotkey = hotkey;
    saveConfig();

    const btn = document.getElementById('pdf-tool-btn');
    if (btn) btn.style.display = buttonVisible ? 'flex' : 'none';

    hideSettingsPanel();
}

                        超长页面会自动降低倍率避免截断
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

                    &amp;lt;label style="display: flex; align-items: center; cursor: pointer;"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;input type="checkbox" id="pdf-preload" checked style="margin-right: 8px; width: 16px; height: 16px; cursor: pointer;"&amp;gt;
                        &amp;lt;span style="font-size: 14px; color: #475569;"&amp;gt;预加载懒加载图片&amp;lt;/span&amp;gt;

                    &amp;lt;div style="margin-top: 5px; margin-left: 26px; font-size: 12px; color: #64748b;"&amp;gt;
                        会自动滚动页面触发图片加载
                    &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;

                &amp;lt;button id="pdf-generate-btn" style="width: 100%; padding: 14px; background: #2563eb; color: white; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s;"&amp;gt;
                    生成 PDF
                &amp;lt;/button&amp;gt;

                &amp;lt;div style="margin-top: 15px; padding: 12px; background: #e0f2fe; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: #0369a1;"&amp;gt;
                    &amp;#128161; 提示：按钮可拖动，快捷键 &amp;lt;strong&amp;gt;${config.hotkey}&amp;lt;/strong&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
    `;

    document.body.appendChild(panel);

    // 事件监听
    document.getElementById('pdf-panel-overlay').addEventListener('click', hidePanel);
    document.getElementById('pdf-close-btn').addEventListener('click', hidePanel);
    document.getElementById('pdf-settings-btn').addEventListener('click', () =&amp;gt; {
        hidePanel();
        setTimeout(showSettingsPanel, 300);
    });
    document.getElementById('pdf-generate-btn').addEventListener('click', handleGenerate);

    // 生成按钮悬停效果
    const genBtn = document.getElementById('pdf-generate-btn');
    genBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () =&amp;gt; {
        genBtn.style.background = '#1d4ed8';
    });
    genBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () =&amp;gt; {
        genBtn.style.background = '#2563eb';
    });

    // 设置按钮悬停效果
    const settingsBtn = document.getElementById('pdf-settings-btn');
    settingsBtn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () =&amp;gt; {
        settingsBtn.style.background = '#e2e8f0';
    });
    settingsBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () =&amp;gt; {
        settingsBtn.style.background = '#f1f5f9';
    });
}

function showPanel() {
    document.getElementById('pdf-tool-panel').style.display = 'block';
    setTimeout(() =&amp;gt; {
        document.getElementById('pdf-panel-content').style.right = '0';
    }, 10);
}

function hidePanel() {
    document.getElementById('pdf-panel-content').style.right = '-350px';
    setTimeout(() =&amp;gt; {
        document.getElementById('pdf-tool-panel').style.display = 'none';
    }, 300);
}

async function handleGenerate() {
    hidePanel();

    const filename = document.getElementById('pdf-filename').value || '网页';
    const orientation = document.getElementById('pdf-orientation').value;
    const format = document.getElementById('pdf-format').value;
    const capture = document.getElementById('pdf-capture').value;
    const quality = parseFloat(document.getElementById('pdf-quality').value);
    const includeImages = document.getElementById('pdf-images').checked;
    const embedImages = document.getElementById('pdf-embed-images').checked;
    const outputType = document.getElementById('pdf-output').value;
    const simplify = document.getElementById('pdf-simplify').checked;
    const autoScale = document.getElementById('pdf-auto-scale').checked;
    const preload = document.getElementById('pdf-preload').checked;

    if (outputType === 'txt' || outputType === 'md') {
        await exportReadable({ filename, capture, includeImages, simplify, preload, exportMd: outputType === 'md' });
        return;
    }

    await generatePDF({ filename, orientation, format, capture, quality, includeImages, embedImages, simplify, autoScale, preload });
}

const MAX_CANVAS_SIZE = 16384;

function computeSafeScale(targetScale, width, height) {
    const scaleByWidth = MAX_CANVAS_SIZE / Math.max(1, width);
    const scaleByHeight = MAX_CANVAS_SIZE / Math.max(1, height);
    const safeScale = Math.min(targetScale, scaleByWidth, scaleByHeight);
    return Math.max(0.5, safeScale);
}

async function delay(ms) {
    return new Promise(resolve =&amp;gt; setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

async function preloadLazyImages() {
    const imgs = Array.from(document.images || []);
    imgs.forEach((img) =&amp;gt; {
        try {
            img.loading = 'eager';
            const dataSrc = img.getAttribute('data-src') || img.getAttribute('data-original') || img.getAttribute('data-lazy-src');
            if (dataSrc &amp;&amp; (!img.src || img.src.includes('data:'))) {
                img.src = dataSrc;
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    });

    const originalScroll = window.scrollY;
    const totalHeight = Math.max(document.documentElement.scrollHeight, document.body.scrollHeight);
    const step = Math.max(window.innerHeight, 800);

    for (let y = 0; y &amp;lt; totalHeight; y += step) {
        window.scrollTo(0, y);
        await delay(150);
    }
    window.scrollTo(0, originalScroll);

    const waitPromises = imgs.map((img) =&amp;gt; {
        if (img.complete) return Promise.resolve();
        return new Promise((resolve) =&amp;gt; {
            const timer = setTimeout(resolve, 2500);
            img.addEventListener('load', () =&amp;gt; {
                clearTimeout(timer);
                resolve();
            }, { once: true });
            img.addEventListener('error', () =&amp;gt; {
                clearTimeout(timer);
                resolve();
            }, { once: true });
        });
    });

    await Promise.race([Promise.all(waitPromises), delay(3000)]);
}

function cleanupText(text) {
    return text.replace(/\s+\n/g, '\n').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
}

function collectImages(container) {
    const imgs = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('img'));
    const list = [];
    imgs.forEach((img) =&amp;gt; {
        const src = img.currentSrc || img.src || img.getAttribute('data-src') || img.getAttribute('data-original') || '';
        if (!src) return;
        const alt = (img.alt || '').trim();
        list.push({ src, alt });
    });
    return list;
}

function extractReadable(container, options) {
    const clone = container.cloneNode(true);

    if (options.simplify) {
        clone.querySelectorAll('nav, header, footer, aside, .sidebar, .ad, .advertisement').forEach(el =&amp;gt; {
            try { el.remove(); } catch (e) {}
        });
    }

    clone.querySelectorAll('script, style, noscript').forEach(el =&amp;gt; {
        try { el.remove(); } catch (e) {}
    });

    const text = cleanupText(clone.innerText || '');
    const images = options.includeImages ? collectImages(clone) : [];
    return { text, images };
}

function downloadTextFile(filename, content, extension) {
    const blob = new Blob([zxsq-anti-bbcode-content], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.download = `${filename}.${extension}`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    setTimeout(() =&amp;gt; {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href);
        link.remove();
    }, 100);
}

function buildMarkdown(title, text, images) {
    let md = `# ${title}\n\n${text}\n`;
    if (images &amp;&amp; images.length &amp;gt; 0) {
        md += `\n\n## Images\n`;
        images.forEach((img) =&amp;gt; {
            const alt = img.alt ? img.alt.replace(/\n/g, ' ') : 'image';
            md += `\n- ![${alt}](${img.src})`;
        });
        md += `\n`;
    }
    return md;
}

async function inlineImages(container, onProgress) {
    const imgs = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('img'));
    let index = 0;
    for (const img of imgs) {
        index += 1;
        if (onProgress) onProgress(index, imgs.length);

        let src = img.currentSrc || img.src || img.getAttribute('data-src') || img.getAttribute('data-original') || '';
        if (!src) continue;
        if (src.startsWith('data:')) continue;

        try {
            const response = await fetch(src, { mode: 'cors', credentials: 'omit' });
            if (!response.ok) continue;
            const blob = await response.blob();
            const dataUrl = await new Promise((resolve) =&amp;gt; {
                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onloadend = () =&amp;gt; resolve(reader.result);
                reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
            });
            img.src = dataUrl;
            img.removeAttribute('srcset');
        } catch (e) {
            img.src = src;
        }
    }
}

async function exportReadable(options) {
    const progress = document.createElement('div');
    progress.id = 'pdf-progress';
    progress.innerHTML = `
        &amp;lt;div style="position: fixed; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: white; padding: 30px 40px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); z-index: 99999999; text-align: center;"&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;div style="width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 3px solid #e5e7eb; border-top-color: #2563eb; border-radius: 50%; animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite; margin: 0 auto 15px;"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; margin-bottom: 5px;"&amp;gt;正在导出文本&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;div style="font-size: 13px; color: #64748b;"&amp;gt;请稍候...&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
        &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
        &amp;lt;style&amp;gt;@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); }}&amp;lt;/style&amp;gt;
    `;
    document.body.appendChild(progress);

    const btn = document.getElementById('pdf-tool-btn');
    if (btn) btn.style.display = 'none';

    try {
        if (options.preload) {
            await preloadLazyImages();
        }

        let element;
        if (options.capture === 'main') {
            element = document.querySelector('main, article, .content, #content, [role="main"]') || document.body;
        } else if (options.capture === 'visible') {
            element = document.documentElement;
        } else {
            element = document.body;
        }

        const { text, images } = extractReadable(element, options);
        const title = document.title || options.filename;

        if (options.exportMd) {
            const md = buildMarkdown(title, text, images);
            downloadTextFile(options.filename, md, 'md');
        } else {
            let content = `${title}\n\n${text}\n`;
            if (images &amp;&amp; images.length &amp;gt; 0) {
                content += `\n\nImages:\n`;
                images.forEach((img) =&amp;gt; {
                    const alt = img.alt ? img.alt.replace(/\n/g, ' ') : 'image';
                    content += `- ${alt}: ${img.src}\n`;
                });
            }
            downloadTextFile(options.filename, content, 'txt');
        }

        progress.querySelector('div &amp;gt; div:nth-child(2)').textContent = '&amp;#9989; 导出成功';
        progress.querySelector('div &amp;gt; div:nth-child(3)').textContent = '文件已保存';
        setTimeout(() =&amp;gt; {
            document.body.removeChild(progress);
            if (btn) btn.style.display = 'flex';
        }, 1200);
    } catch (error) {
        alert('导出失败: ' + error.message);
        if (progress) document.body.removeChild(progress);
        if (btn) btn.style.display = 'flex';
    }
}

async function generatePDF(options) {
    try {
        const progress = document.createElement('div');
        progress.id = 'pdf-progress';
        progress.innerHTML = `
            &amp;lt;div style="position: fixed; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); background: white; padding: 30px 40px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); z-index: 99999999; text-align: center;"&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div style="width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 3px solid #e5e7eb; border-top-color: #2563eb; border-radius: 50%; animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite; margin: 0 auto 15px;"&amp;gt;&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div style="font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; margin-bottom: 5px;"&amp;gt;正在生成 PDF&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
                &amp;lt;div style="font-size: 13px; color: #64748b;"&amp;gt;请稍候...&amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;/div&amp;gt;
            &amp;lt;style&amp;gt;@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); }}&amp;lt;/style&amp;gt;
        `;
        document.body.appendChild(progress);

        const btn = document.getElementById('pdf-tool-btn');
        if (btn) btn.style.display = 'none';

        await new Promise(resolve =&amp;gt; setTimeout(resolve, 100));

        let element;
        if (options.capture === 'main') {
            element = document.querySelector('main, article, .content, #content, [role="main"]') || document.body;
        } else if (options.capture === 'visible') {
            element = document.documentElement;
        } else {
            element = document.body;
        }

        if (options.preload) {
            progress.querySelector('div &amp;gt; div:nth-child(2)').textContent = '正在加载页面资源';
            progress.querySelector('div &amp;gt; div:nth-child(3)').textContent = '请稍候...';
            await preloadLazyImages();
        }

        let finalOrientation = options.orientation;
        if (finalOrientation === 'auto') {
            const width = element.scrollWidth || element.offsetWidth;
            const height = element.scrollHeight || element.offsetHeight;
            finalOrientation = width &amp;gt; height ? 'landscape' : 'portrait';
        }

        let finalFormat = options.format;
        if (finalFormat === 'auto') {
            const width = element.scrollWidth || element.offsetWidth;
            const height = element.scrollHeight || element.offsetHeight;
            finalFormat = [width * 0.264583, height * 0.264583];
        }

        const contentWidth = element.scrollWidth || element.offsetWidth || document.documentElement.scrollWidth;
        const contentHeight = element.scrollHeight || element.offsetHeight || document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
        const targetScale = 2;
        const safeScale = options.autoScale ? computeSafeScale(targetScale, contentWidth, contentHeight) : targetScale;

        const opt = {
            margin: 10,
            filename: options.filename + '.pdf',
            image: { type: 'jpeg', quality: options.quality },
            html2canvas: {
                scale: safeScale,
                useCORS: true,
                logging: false,
                backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                windowWidth: contentWidth,
                windowHeight: contentHeight,
                scrollX: 0,
                scrollY: -window.scrollY,
                ignoreElements: (el) =&amp;gt; {
                    return el.id === 'pdf-tool-btn' || el.id === 'pdf-progress' ||
                           el.id === 'pdf-tool-panel' || el.id === 'pdf-settings-panel';
                },
                onclone: (clonedDoc) =&amp;gt; {
                    if (options.simplify) {
                        // 简化模式：温和优化
                        clonedDoc.querySelectorAll('nav, header, footer, aside, .sidebar, .ad, .advertisement').forEach(el =&amp;gt; {
                            try { el.remove(); } catch (e) {}
                        });
                    }

                    if (!options.includeImages) {
                        clonedDoc.querySelectorAll('img').forEach(img =&amp;gt; img.remove());
                    } else if (options.embedImages) {
                        const imgs = Array.from(clonedDoc.querySelectorAll('img'));
                        const sourceImgs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('img'));
                        imgs.forEach((img, idx) =&amp;gt; {
                            const source = sourceImgs[zxsq-anti-bbcode-idx];
                            if (!source) return;
                            const src = source.currentSrc || source.src;
                            if (!src || !src.startsWith('data:')) return;
                            img.src = src;
                            img.removeAttribute('srcset');
                        });
                    }
                }
            },
            jsPDF: {
                unit: 'mm',
                format: finalFormat,
                orientation: finalOrientation
            }
        };

        if (options.includeImages &amp;&amp; options.embedImages) {
            progress.querySelector('div &amp;gt; div:nth-child(2)').textContent = '正在内嵌图片';
            progress.querySelector('div &amp;gt; div:nth-child(3)').textContent = '处理图片中...';
            await inlineImages(element, (current, total) =&amp;gt; {
                const text = `处理图片 ${current}/${total}`;
                progress.querySelector('div &amp;gt; div:nth-child(3)').textContent = text;
            });
        }

        await html2pdf().set(opt).from(element).save();

        progress.querySelector('div &amp;gt; div:nth-child(2)').textContent = '&amp;#9989; 生成成功';
        progress.querySelector('div &amp;gt; div:nth-child(3)').textContent = 'PDF已保存';

        setTimeout(() =&amp;gt; {
            document.body.removeChild(progress);
            if (btn) btn.style.display = 'flex';
        }, 1500);

    } catch (error) {
        alert('PDF生成失败: ' + error.message);

        const progress = document.getElementById('pdf-progress');
        if (progress) document.body.removeChild(progress);

        const btn = document.getElementById('pdf-tool-btn');
        if (btn) btn.style.display = 'flex';
    }
}

async function init() {
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        await new Promise(resolve =&amp;gt; {
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', resolve);
        });
    }

    await waitForLibrary();

    setTimeout(() =&amp;gt; {
        createDraggableButton();
        createPanel();
        createSettingsPanel();
        setupHotkey();
    }, 1000);
}

init();</code></pre>

<ol>
<li>打开 Tampermonkey 面板 → 点击“添加新脚本”</li>
<li>删除编辑器里原有内容</li>
<li>复制 <code>web-to-pdf-v2.user.js</code> 全部代码，粘贴进去</li>
<li>点击“文件 → 保存”（或 <code>Ctrl+S</code>）</li>
<li>刷新网页后即可使用</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="54948086_使用">使用</h3>
<ol>
<li>打开任意网页</li>
<li>点击右下角的 PDF 按钮</li>
<li>设置导出选项</li>
<li>点击"生成 PDF"</li>
</ol>
<h4 id="54948086_快捷键">快捷键</h4>
<p>按 <code>Alt+U</code> 可直接打开面板。</p>
<h4 id="54948086_设置">设置</h4>
<p>点击面板右上角的齿轮图标可以：</p>
<ul>
<li>隐藏悬浮按钮</li>
<li>修改快捷键</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="54948086_选项说明">选项说明</h3>
<p><strong>页面方向</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>自动检测：根据页面宽高自动选择</li>
<li>纵向/横向：手动指定</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>页面格式</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>自适应：按实际页面大小</li>
<li>A4/A3/Letter/Legal：标准纸张</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>捕获范围</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>主要内容：只保存正文部分</li>
<li>整个页面：包含所有内容</li>
<li>可见区域：当前屏幕显示的部分</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>导出类型</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>PDF</li>
<li>纯文本（.txt）</li>
<li>Markdown（.md）<br>
选择文本类型时会导出文件，不生成 PDF。</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>图片质量</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>高质量：文件大，清晰</li>
<li>标准：平衡</li>
<li>压缩：文件小</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>PDF 内嵌图片</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>生成 PDF 前把图片转为内嵌数据，减少缺失</li>
<li>会增加生成时间</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Markdown 说明</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>输出为 Markdown，正文 + 图片列表链接</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>简化样式（兼容模式）</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>勾选后会移除导航、侧边栏、广告等干扰元素</li>
<li>适用于页面元素过多的网站</li>
<li>保留原始样式，只是去掉无关内容</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>自动缩放防截断</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>超长页面时自动降低渲染倍率，避免被浏览器画布高度限制截断</li>
<li>会略微降低清晰度，但能保证完整性</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>预加载懒加载图片</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>生成前自动滚动页面触发图片加载</li>
<li>可减少图片缺失或空白</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="54948086_常见问题">常见问题</h3>
<p><strong>生成失败怎么办？</strong></p>
<p>尝试：</p>
<ul>
<li>勾选"简化样式（兼容模式）"</li>
<li>选择"主要内容"而不是"整个页面"</li>
<li>降低图片质量</li>
<li>取消"包含图片"</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>为什么有些网站无法生成PDF？</strong></p>
<p>可能的原因：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>跨域限制</strong>：网站禁止外部访问资源（图片、字体等）</li>
<li><strong>动态加载</strong>：内容通过 JavaScript 动态加载，需等待加载完成</li>
<li><strong>复杂样式</strong>：使用了大量 CSS 动画、变换或现代颜色函数</li>
<li><strong>Canvas/SVG</strong>：包含复杂的图形元素</li>
<li><strong>iframe 内容</strong>：嵌入的第三方内容无法捕获</li>
<li><strong>懒加载图片</strong>：图片未加载完成就开始生成（脚本会自动等待1.5秒）</li>
</ul>
<p>解决方法：</p>
<ol>
<li>滚动到页面底部，确保所有内容加载完成</li>
<li>等待页面完全渲染后再生成（特别是有懒加载的页面）</li>
<li>使用"简化样式"模式</li>
<li>选择"主要内容"而不是"整个页面"</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>PDF 被截断或底部缺失？</strong></p>
<p>尝试：</p>
<ol>
<li>勾选“自动缩放防截断”</li>
<li>勾选“预加载懒加载图片”</li>
<li>将“捕获范围”改为“主要内容”</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>PDF 图片缺失或空白？</strong></p>
<p>尝试：</p>
<ol>
<li>勾选“PDF 内嵌图片”</li>
<li>勾选“预加载懒加载图片”</li>
<li>等页面图片完全加载后再生成</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>导出文本时图片怎么办？</strong></p>
<p>勾选“包含图片”后，会在导出的 <code>.txt/.md</code> 末尾追加图片链接（Markdown 会用 <code>![alt](url)</code> 格式）。</p>
<p><strong>脚本不生效 / 按钮不显示？</strong></p>
<p>尝试：</p>
<ol>
<li>确认 Tampermonkey 已启用该脚本</li>
<li>刷新页面或重开浏览器</li>
<li>检查网页是否屏蔽脚本或有严格的内容安全策略（CSP）</li>
<li>在设置里开启“显示悬浮按钮”，或用快捷键 <code>Alt+U</code> 打开面板</li>
<li>切换到“主要内容”或开启“简化样式（兼容模式）”</li>
<li>通过 Tampermonkey 图标查看当前页面是否已运行该脚本</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>如何只用快捷键？</strong></p>
<p>在设置中取消勾选"显示悬浮按钮"，之后用 Alt+U 打开。</p>
<p><strong>PDF 是空白的？</strong></p>
<p>等页面完全加载后再生成。</p>
